# Rao & Co HVAC

> Rao & Co is an engineering-led HVAC and air conditioning company based in Jayanagar, Bengaluru, operating since 2015. We provide HVAC design, installation, air conditioning supply, AMC maintenance, repairs, commercial and industrial HVAC, and ventilation across Bengaluru.

## Contact
- Phone: +91 70226 00797
- Email: info@raoandco.in
- Address: No. 5/A, 27th Cross, 7th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560070, India
- Website: https://raoandco.in

## Services
- HVAC Design & Engineering: Accurate load calculations and system planning that make cooling systems efficient, right-sized and dependable. https://raoandco.in/services/hvac-design-engineering
- HVAC Installation & Commissioning: Professional execution and commissioning so every system operates safely and performs exactly as designed. https://raoandco.in/services/hvac-installation-commissioning
- Air Conditioning Solutions: Supply and deployment of split, ducted, VRF and centralized air conditioning systems for every environment. https://raoandco.in/services/air-conditioning-solutions
- Maintenance & AMC Services: Preventive maintenance programs structured to sustain efficiency and reduce unexpected system failures. https://raoandco.in/services/maintenance-amc-services
- Repair & Breakdown Services: Fast technical troubleshooting and repairs that restore system performance without temporary patchwork. https://raoandco.in/services/repair-breakdown-services
- Commercial & Industrial HVAC: Engineered cooling solutions designed for large commercial, industrial and mission-critical facilities. https://raoandco.in/services/commercial-industrial-hvac
- Ventilation & Air Distribution: Fresh-air, exhaust and air-distribution systems that keep indoor environments healthy and balanced. https://raoandco.in/services/ventilation-air-distribution
